Hector: Sunday quick poll \u2014 flea market hunt (9am) or long bike loop + tacos at the pier (11am)? :bicycle: :taco:
Lin: Flea market for me. love poking for vintage cameras. anyone want to carpool?
Jo: Bike loop sounds perfect. I can bring a tire pump + spare tube in case.
Priya: Ooh vintage cameras!! but I also need a lazy day. I9d vote flea market if it9s not raining.
Hector: Forecast says partly cloudy, 10% chance of rain. Might be fine for either.
Lin: If flea market wins, I can grab coffee for the crew. Jo, any chance you can bring a small rack for any fragile finds if I buy them?
Jo: I9m already bringing a pannier, I can stash small stuff.
Priya: What time is the flea market opening? 9am ok for most?
Hector: Market stalls usually pop up by 9. Bike loop meetup could be 11 at the north end.
lunch-bot: poll: "Sunday plans" options: [FleaMarket9am, Bike+Tacos11am] current votes: FleaMarket9am (2), Bike+Tacos11am (1)
Jo: Looks like flea market is ahead. if people want tacos after we can pivot to pier lunch around 1pm.
Lin: Perfect. I9ll bring cash and a reusable tote. anyone need help hauling heavy vintage stereo units? :sweat_smile:
Priya: I9ll be on tote duty. and coffee procurement. thanks Lin!
Hector: Great. I9ll add an event and DM the location. Flea market it is. See y9all Sunday 9am by the west entrance.
Lin: See you Sunday. excited for camera hunting :camera_with_flash:
